title: Zoning text change to require affordable housing at 1166 Bedford Avenue
summary: This application would establish a Mandatory Inclusionary Housing area for a site at 1166 Bedford Avenue in Bedford-Stuyvesant, Brooklyn. Combined with a related zoning map change, it would support a new 12-story building with about 144 income-restricted apartments, 13,400 square feet of community facility space and 4,800 square feet of ground-floor retail. The City Planning Commission approved the application on June 17, 2026, and the Council's Land Use Committee recommended approval on July 14, 2026.
